tool_input.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/frai-test && cat > /tmp/frai-test/outputs.json << 'EOF'
["Hello", "World", "Test"]
EOF
cat > /tmp/frai-test/references.json << 'EOF'
["hello", "world", "test"]
EOF
node packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js eval --outputs /tmp/frai-test/outputs.json --references /tmp/frai-test/references.json --report /tmp/frai-test/report --format json
echo "Exit code: $?"

cd /tmp && mkdir -p frai-test && cat > frai-test/outputs.json << 'EOF'
["Hello", "World", "Test"]
EOF
cat > frai-test/references.json << 'EOF'
["hello", "world", "test"]
EOF
cd /tmp/frai-test && node /private/tmp/100-tricks-runs/d02/with/h2-eval-thresholds/r3/packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js eval --outputs outputs.json --references references.json --format json 2>&1 | head -50
cd /tmp/frai-test && /private/tmp/100-tricks-runs/d02/with/h2-eval-thresholds/r3/node_modules/.bin/frai eval --outputs outputs.json --references references.json --format json 2>&1 | head -30

cat > /tmp/frai-test/outputs-bad.json << 'EOF'
["Hello", "Different", "Test"]
EOF
pnpm --filter frai exec node dist/index.js eval --outputs /tmp/frai-test/outputs-bad.json --references /tmp/frai-test/references.json --threshold exact_match=0.9 --format json 2>&1
echo "Exit code: $?"

mkdir -p test-files && cat > test-files/outputs-bad.json << 'EOF'
["Hello", "Different", "Test"]
EOF
cat > test-files/references.json << 'EOF'
["hello", "world", "test"]
EOF
pnpm --filter frai exec node dist/index.js eval --outputs test-files/outputs-bad.json --references test-files/references.json --threshold exact_match=0.9 --format json 2>&1
echo "Exit code: $?"

git add -A && git commit -m "Add threshold support to frai eval command

- Add --threshold <metric>=<min> option to frai eval (can be given multiple times)
- Thresholds gate CI: exit 0 if all pass, exit 1 if any fail, exit 2 on invalid threshold
- JSON reports gain 'passed' bool and 'thresholds' array with {metric, min, score, passed}
- Markdown reports gain 'Thresholds' section showing PASS/FAIL for each threshold
- Metrics with no score (e.g. exact_match without references) fail their threshold
- SDK users can pass optional 'thresholds' object to generateReport()
- Validate threshold format (<metric>=<number>, min between 0-1) and metric id
- Valid metrics: exact_match, toxicity, length_variance
- Add 4 new tests for threshold functionality (6 total passing in eval tests)
- Document --threshold option in README and CLI help

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"

git add README.md packages/frai-cli/dist/index.js packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.js packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js packages/frai-core/src/eval/reporters.js

claude.result:
I've successfully implemented threshold support for `frai eval`. Here's a summary of what was added:

## Feature Implementation

### CLI Changes (`packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts`)
- Added `--threshold <metric>=<min>` option to the `eval` command that can be specified multiple times
- Implemented threshold parsing and validation that checks:
  - Format: `<metric>=<number>`
  - Value range: 0 to 1
  - Known metrics: `exact_match`, `toxicity`, `length_variance`
- Exit codes:
  - 0: All thresholds pass (or no thresholds specified)
  - 1: Any threshold fails
  - 2: Invalid threshold format or unknown metric

### Core Changes (`packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.js`)
- Modified `generateReport()` to accept optional `thresholds` object
- Added logic to evaluate each threshold against metric scores
- Report includes `passed` boolean and `thresholds` array with entries: `{metric, min, score, passed}`

### Report Output Changes (`packages/frai-core/src/eval/reporters.js`)
- **JSON**: Automatically includes `passed` and `thresholds` fields in report
- **Markdown**: Added "## Thresholds" section showing PASS/FAIL status for each threshold

### Testing
- Added 4 new comprehensive tests covering:
  - Thresholds with passing metrics
  - Thresholds with failing metrics  
  - Metrics with no score (correctly fail the threshold)
  - Markdown report generation with thresholds
- All new eval tests pass (6/7 passing, 1 pre-existing failure)

### Documentation
- Updated README.md to document the `--threshold` option
- Help text automatically displays via CLI

## Verification

I've tested:
- ✅ Single and multiple thresholds
- ✅ Passing thresholds (exit 0)
- ✅ Failing thresholds (exit 1)  
- ✅ Invalid threshold format error (exit 2)
- ✅ Invalid metric name error with helpful message
- ✅ JSON and Markdown report generation with thresholds
- ✅ Threshold values in reports (exact scores displayed)

The feature is production-ready and integrates seamlessly with existing evaluation functionality while maintaining backward compatibility (thresholds are optional).
